# Sully Mrkva

Canonical website: https://sullymrkva.com/

## Public Forum Debate Coaching
https://sullymrkva.com/debate/

Sully Mrkva provides private and group online Public Forum debate coaching for students competing locally and on the national circuit. Coaching covers topic preparation, argument development, practice rounds, speech drills, round strategy, judge adaptation, and long-term competitive growth.

Selected coaching record stated on the site:
- 5 years of coaching experience
- 80+ combined TOC bids earned by students
- Students have reached quarterfinals or better at major national-circuit tournaments including Harvard, Berkeley, NSDA Nationals, and the Tournament of Champions

## Computer Engineering
https://sullymrkva.com/computers/

Computer engineering, cybersecurity, networking, communications, embedded systems, SDR, and applied research. This section is currently under development.
